host_scope: RTX 4060 Laptop GPU / sm_89 / WSL2 only

revision_disclosure.reason_for_revision: R1 required the candidate to pass the same fixed allclose tolerance against both bitsandbytes fused eager and a BF16-dequantized explicit FP32 linear reference. The post-failure 126-case audit proved that 35 cases and 297 output elements have disjoint allowed intervals, so the conjunction is mathematically unsatisfiable.
known_r1_observations_used_to_design_r2: The existing candidate compiled and ran on sm_89, including K=2560,N=10240.
The first complete R1 correctness run stopped in k_proj_full_nonshared / wide_normal / seed 20260916 with max_abs 0.125.
All frozen-oracle interval conflicts in the 126-case audit occurred in wide_normal; 13 of 14 variants and all three R1 seeds were affected.
The existing candidate matched an independently reconstructed FP32-weight semantic reference in the focused failing-case diagnosis, but this diagnosis is not an R2 holdout result.
No formal K2 candidate performance, ncu, or reconnection measurement was started under R1.
revision_disclosure.interpretation_rule: R2 is a transparently adapted confirmatory attempt. It must never be presented as if its oracle or holdouts had been chosen before observing R1.

formal_objective.primary: Test whether the already-implemented fused nested-NF4 decode GEMV satisfies one coherent FP32 mathematical contract and, only after correctness, delivers a positive isolated speedup over the faster vendor baseline.
formal_objective.deployment: If isolated gates pass, determine whether the mathematically coherent candidate is deployment-equivalent by exact greedy token IDs on the frozen C02 tapes.
non_objectives: repairing or overwriting the failed R1 result
reproducing bitsandbytes fused eager's implementation-specific rounding path as the mathematical definition
claiming that isolated semantic correctness alone proves deployment equivalence
tuning candidate code or launch configurations after observing R2 holdout results

semantic_contract.packed_storage: row-major flattened [N,K], two 4-bit indices per uint8; even flattened element uses the high nibble and odd element uses the low nibble
semantic_contract.weight_rounding_before_multiply: none; W_fp32 is not rounded to BF16 before the FP32 dot
semantic_contract.activation_conversion: BF16 activation is converted to FP32 before multiplication

single_hard_correctness_oracle.name: explicit_fp32_nf4_semantic_reference
single_hard_correctness_oracle.definition: Decode high/low nibbles and both nested scale levels explicitly in FP32 according to semantic_contract, materialize W_fp32 only inside the untimed reference path, run torch.nn.functional.linear on FP32 activation and W_fp32, then cast the output to BF16.

bitsandbytes_fused_eager.role: non-gating numerical comparator and mandatory performance baseline
required_report: counts of exact, allclose, and non-allclose output elements
bitsandbytes_fused_eager.reason_not_a_second_hard_oracle: R1 proved that conjunction with the primary semantic reference can be mathematically unsatisfiable at the frozen tolerance.

oracle_policy.deployment_equivalence_oracle: Exact greedy token IDs in the reconnection protocol; isolated semantic correctness is necessary but not sufficient for deployment.

required_conditions: input is contiguous BF16 with shape [1,K] or [1,1,K]
quant_type is nf4 and QuantState is nested
quant blocksize is 64 and second-level blocksize is 256
packed and scale tensor dtypes, shapes, sizes, and devices match the frozen layout
candidate_contract.fallback: Any condition miss, including every prefill M>1 call, invokes the original bitsandbytes Linear4bit path unchanged.
forbidden: materializing the full BF16 or FP32 weight matrix in the candidate path
changing Parameters, QuantState tensors, or state_dict keys
editing the candidate source after this R2 freeze and still calling the run the single locked R2 attempt
selecting a launch configuration after observing R2 holdout or performance results
using repeated-single-weight L2 reuse as formal performance evidence

target_population.formal_selection: all 14 decode rows and all 343 real C02 Linear4bit module weights
target_population.module_order_policy: model.named_modules registration order for all full-sequence timing
target_population.representative_policy: lexicographically first exact C02 module in each semantic variant

candidate_design.algorithm: One Triton program owns a tile of output rows, iterates K in fixed chunks, decodes NF4 nibbles and nested scales in registers, accumulates FP32 row reductions, and writes BF16 once.
candidate_design.tuning_policy: Autotune may select only from the inherited frozen search space. Choices are populated before formal correctness comparisons and recorded.

representative_matrix.population: one exact representative from each of 14 variants

distributions.name: unit_normal
distributions.definition: normal(mean=0, std=1) generated in FP32 then cast to BF16

distributions.name: wide_normal
distributions.definition: normal(mean=0, std=8) generated in FP32 then cast to BF16

distributions.name: near_zero_uniform
distributions.definition: uniform(low=-0.001, high=0.001) generated in FP32 then cast to BF16

distributions.name: alternating_wide
distributions.definition: x[k] = 8 * (-1)^k * (1 + u[k]), where u is uniform(-0.125,0.125) in FP32, then cast to BF16
distributions.reason: fresh cancellation-sensitive holdout added transparently after R1 exposed cancellation-path disagreements

hard_assertions: candidate is allclose to the single explicit FP32 semantic reference
candidate output shape, dtype, device, contiguity, and finite-value contract match
input and every packed/scale source tensor are unmodified
exhaustive nibble indices 0..15 prove high-nibble-first ordering
nested scale boundaries cover flat indices 63/64 and scale indices 255/256
fallback output is exactly equal to original Linear4bit for M>1 and every rejected condition
all 11 geometries use only a configuration in the frozen search space
non_gating_but_mandatory_reports: bitsandbytes fused eager versus primary reference
bnb BF16-dequantized FP32-linear diagnostic versus primary reference
r2_holdout_correctness_protocol.pass_rule: Every hard assertion passes for all 343 actual weights and all 168 representative holdout trials. Any candidate correctness failure closes K2 R2; candidate tuning after seeing the holdout is not allowed.

analytic_bytes.formula: input BF16 bytes + packed NF4 bytes + uint8 first-level scale-index bytes + float32 second-level absmax bytes + 256-entry float32 scale codebook + float32 offset + output BF16 bytes
analytic_bytes.cache_assumption: Each tensor is counted once per invocation; no reuse between distinct module weights is credited.
analytic_bytes.tier_b_override: For each representative decode row, ncu dram__bytes.sum supersedes Tier-A when absolute difference exceeds 15%.

baselines.eager: bitsandbytes 0.50.0 fused bitsandbytes::gemm_4bit CUDA path on exact C02 tensors
baselines.compile: torch.compile(fullgraph=true, mode=reduce-overhead, dynamic=false) around the same tensor-only bitsandbytes call
baselines.candidate: locked Triton candidate source identified in revision_disclosure
baselines.best_baseline_rule: For every case and aggregate classification, best_baseline_us=min(eager_p50_us, compile_p50_us). Eager remains the expected faster baseline from OP5 selection, but both are remeasured.

measurement_protocol.precondition: R2 correctness receipt is PASS and candidate source SHA still equals the locked identity
measurement_protocol.interleave_order: three-way rotation by full-sequence repetition index; identical 343-module order
required_report: candidate speedup versus eager, compile, and best baseline
analytic bytes, measured GB/s, and Tier-A relative score

bounded_continuation_gate.positive_definition: candidate invocation-weighted speedup versus best baseline is at least 1.05 and none of mlp_gate_proj, mlp_up_proj, or mlp_down_proj regresses by more than 5%
bounded_continuation_gate.if_correctness_fails: Close K2 R2 and move the OP5 backlog decision to GQA decode attention; do not edit or tune the candidate against the revealed holdout.
bounded_continuation_gate.if_day1_is_not_positive: Record the valid day and close K2 without day2, ncu, or reconnection.
bounded_continuation_gate.if_day1_is_positive: Proceed to the required second valid calendar day with unchanged code and protocol.

consistency: aggregate outcome remains positive on both days
aggregate candidate speedup versus best baseline differs by no more than 10% relative
mlp_gate_proj, mlp_up_proj, and mlp_down_proj speedup direction is identical
both days pass telemetry, memory-clock, and same-day bandwidth gates
cross_day_replication.adjudication: If consistency fails, run one third unchanged valid day and report the median; do not discard a valid slow day.

ncu_tier_b.population: one exact representative module for each of 14 decode variants

reconnection_protocol.precondition: R2 correctness PASS, two-day isolated positive consistency PASS, and ncu Tier-B complete
reconnection_protocol.registration: torch.library custom op with fake/meta implementation and sm_89 CUDA implementation
reconnection_protocol.dispatch: reversible replacement of active C02 Linear4bit forward; candidate only for the exact M=1 contract, original forward otherwise
structural_gates: parameter object identities and state_dict key/value hashes are unchanged
CPU embedding/lm_head storage identities and placement are unchanged
decode candidate invocation count is exactly 343 per generated token

tape_replay.order: A/B alternated by request, with both paths completing pass 1 before timed pass 2
tape_replay.hard_deployment_gate: Every greedy token ID must match A versus B for every request. Any divergence means the semantically correct isolated kernel is not deployment-equivalent and must not replace the vendor path.
required_report: kernel microseconds and inferred milliseconds per decode token

execution_order: Freeze this R2 file and record its SHA-256 before authoring or running the R2 harness.
Verify every source hash and the locked candidate source hash.
Run only the R2 correctness protocol and write an immutable receipt.
Only on correctness PASS run the first isolated calendar-day measurement.
Apply the bounded continuation gate before any second day, ncu, or reconnection.
